input.quote: 20.1 Vendor shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer, its Affiliates, and their directors, officers, employees, and agents from each third-party claim and resulting damages, settlements, judgments, penalties, costs, and reasonable attorneys' fees arising from an allegation that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate an intellectual property right.
input.rationale: The indemnity package meets the preferred position in full. Section 20.1 gives an uncapped-in-scope Vendor IP defence and indemnity covering Customer, its Affiliates and their personnel for claims that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate IP, with no Customer-modification/combination/specification exclusions cut into the grant. Section 20.2 adds Vendor indemnities for breach of Applicable Law, bodily injury/property damage, unauthorised access to or disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor, and Vendor's gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud — matching (b)-(d) of our model language. Section 20.4 is a balanced, reciprocal procedure (prompt notice, cooperation at the indemnifying party's expense, control of defence, delay excusing only to the extent of material prejudice, and no adverse settlement without consent). Section 20.5 provides the infringement remedies (procure, modify/replace without materially reducing functionality, or terminate and refund on a straight-line three-year basis), with Vendor barred from terminating unaffected Services, and is reinforced by the termination right in Section 9.3. Customer's reciprocal indemnity in Section 20.3 is appropriately narrow — limited to unmodified Customer-supplied material used strictly as authorised and Customer's own violation of Applicable Law, with express carve-outs for Vendor Technology, modification, combination or instructions. Section 21.3 treats indemnification obligations as Excluded Claims, so Vendor's indemnities sit outside the liability cap; this is better than the fallback's 3× super-cap and requires no change. No redline proposed.
